contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

lineTraces.description: The generated line traces of this solution version. Every entry must pin the set's solutionId/versionNumber/snapshot (invariant trace_set_version_pin_mismatch).

boqLineId.description: Identity of the GENERATED solution-BOQ line (a derived projection — the source BOQ, if any, remains a separate source/revision that is never silently overwritten).

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

contributingOperations.description: The solution steps that produced/changed/removed this line — NEVER empty: every generated BOQ line traces to at least one operation (schema-level minimum).

operationIndex.description: The contributing operation's 1-based position in the solution version's sequence.

geometryRefs.description: Geometry references the line's quantity derives from (geometry provenance).

ref.description: Stable id of the referenced geometry artifact (owned by the deterministic geometry services; read-only reference).

itemDescription.description: The generated line's item description (derived wording; source BOQ wording rules apply to source BOQs, which stay separate).

quantity.description: The line's typed quantity with explicit unit and calculation provenance (calculationRef) — the deterministic quantity derivation of PROD-025.

calculationRef.description: Reference to the deterministic calculation/method that produced the value (calculation provenance).

uncertainty.description: Propagated measurement uncertainty where stated; absent means 'not stated' — never zero, never fabricated.

unit.description: Explicit unit (REQUIRED — a quantity is never a bare number).

value.description: Quantity value in the stated unit.

solutionId.description: The solution whose version produced this line (version pin).

traceId.description: Deterministic trace identity (deriveSolutionBoqLineTraceId): sha-256 over {solutionId, versionNumber, boqLineId} — pinned to the solution VERSION that produced the line.

validationSnapshotRef.description: The DECLARED validation snapshot the BOQ generation used (never absent — a solution BOQ exists only tied to a snapshot).

versionNumber.description: The solution VERSION that produced this line (version pin — the trace never floats across versions).

solutionId.description: The solution whose version this trace set pins.

validationSnapshotRef.description: The ONE declared validation snapshot the set was generated from (echoed by every line trace — invariant trace_set_snapshot_pin).

versionNumber.description: The solution VERSION this trace set pins (version pin).
